description: This file defines a C++ class `lssMsg` for handling secure stream messages within the libwebsockets framework, including related callback functions for receive, transmit, and state management.

classes.name: lssMsg
classes.description: A class managing secure stream messages, encapsulating callbacks for receive, transmit, and state changes, and inheriting from the base `lss` class.

methods.name: lssMsg
methods.description: Constructor initializing the secure stream message object with context, component, and URI.

methods.name: lssmsg_rx
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon receiving data on the stream.

methods.name: lssmsg_tx
methods.description: Callback function to handle data transmission, currently indicating no data to send.

methods.name: lssmsg_state
methods.description: Callback function invoked on state changes of the stream.
